concept: Adult dawn ballet rehearsal on dry wooden platform inside a conservatory; ivory long-sleeved leotard, short charcoal skirt, soft slippers, music notebook and closed violin case behind her, blue window dawn and warm practical lamp, full-body slight frontal offset.

all_of: Both feet belong to the dancer and stand apart slightly beyond hip width in the same floor plane.
Both toes point outward in opposite directions.
Both soles and heels are visibly grounded.
confusable_wrong_answers: Parallel toes in a squat stance
targets.pass_rule: All components visible and present; partial is FAIL; obscured or cropped required components are UNOBSERVABLE.

all_of: Both knees track outward in the direction of the matching toes.
Pelvis stays between grounded feet beneath an upright torso.
Both heels remain grounded in this same instant.
confusable_wrong_answers: Inward knee collapse over outward feet
targets.pass_rule: All components visible and present; partial is FAIL; unseen depth or heel interface is UNOBSERVABLE.

all_of: Both arms connect to the dancer and curve overhead.
Both elbows are softly bent to form one rounded oval.
Both hands sit above the head with an air gap between fingertips.
Shoulders remain visibly lowered relative to ears.
confusable_wrong_answers: One arm high and one sideways
targets.pass_rule: All components visible and present; partial is FAIL; small/hidden fingertips or cropped arm oval are UNOBSERVABLE.

scene_all_of: one compatible still geometry for all three target terms
ivory long-sleeved leotard and short charcoal skirt
cool dawn window light plus warm practical lamp
entire overhead oval, feet, knees and floor contacts visible

controls_intent.expression: composed camera gaze and scoop neckline lend subtle intimate appeal in a quiet rehearsal scene; no added fetish or surreal treatment

claim_limits: Native pose appearance only, not actual forces or biomechanics
Visible face/hair only, not identity, biological similarity or personality
Agent review only, not user acceptance
compatibility_review: Second position plus shallow plie both use both flat feet; no simultaneous pointe or lifted foot role.
Rounded overhead hands remain empty; all musical props rest behind the dance area.
The score/notebook draws are reconciled as one notebook of annotated music.
A dry platform makes the conservatory setting compatible with grounded practice.
A short skirt and slight frontal camera offset preserve knees and foot direction.
primary_direction_comparison: A formal plant-and-body symmetry could make the dancer look like a pose demonstration.
Selected: a private dawn practice beat with warm face light, music traces and soft camera acknowledgement, while the body geometry stays readable.
